name: -h
--help
options.description: Show help, with an operation its options

name: -k
--check
options.description: Test local database for validity (-kk for sync databases)

options.name: --disable-sandbox
options.description: Disables all sandbox features used for the downloader process

options.name: --disable-sandbox-filesystem
options.description: Disables the filesystem part of the downloader process sandbox

options.name: --disable-sandbox-syscalls
options.description: Disables the syscalls part of the downloader process sandbox

options.name: --gpgdir
options.description: Set an alternate home directory for GnuPG

options.name: --noconfirm
options.description: Do not ask for any confirmation

options.name: --sysroot
options.description: Operate on a mounted guest system (root-only)

name: -l
--list
options.description: List the files owned by the queried package

name: -y
--refresh
options.description: Download fresh package databases from the server

name: -c
--changelog
options.description: View the changelog of a package

name: -g
--groups
options.description: View all members of a package group

name: -i
--info
options.description: View package information (-ii for backup files)

name: -m
--foreign
options.description: List installed packages not found in sync db(s) [filter]

name: -n
--native
options.description: List installed packages only found in sync db(s) [filter]

name: -t
--unrequired
options.description: List packages not (optionally) required by any

options.name: --cascade
options.description: Remove packages and all packages that depend on them

options.name: --nodeps
options.description: Skip dependency version checks (-dd to skip all checks)

options.name: --print
options.description: Print the targets instead of performing the operation

options.name: --assume-installed
options.description: Add a virtual package to satisfy dependencies

options.name: --dbonly
options.description: Only modify database entries, not package files

options.name: --noprogressbar
options.description: Do not show a progress bar when downloading files

options.name: --noscriptlet
options.description: Do not execute the install scriptlet if one exists

options.name: --print-format
options.description: Specify how the targets should be printed

options.name: --clean
options.description: Remove old packages from cache directory (-cc for all)

name: -w
--downloadonly
options.description: Download packages but do not install/upgrade anything

options.name: --ignore
options.description: Ignore a package upgrade (can be used more than once)

options.name: --ignoregroup
options.description: Ignore a group upgrade (can be used more than once)

options.name: --needed
options.description: Do not reinstall up to date packages

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite conflicting files (can be used more than once)
